title: Donate for purpose
tagline: There is corruption all around the place and we aim to fix it
description:
Corruption:
Does your earned money is used where it is supposed to be?
What if you donate it to the most nicest person and later find out he is using it for useless parties?
How can we solve this?
We can use web2 but there will be lot of limitations.

We are going to solve this using web3
how_its_made:
With EVM we can use smart contracts to solve this. Custom token can be used to handle the donations and limiting where it can be used. With it bad actors cannot exploit this valuable money.

We have created a frontend in NextJS where we integrate the smart contract, then with it we can show user pages and the provider and person can handle his funds
